description.value: The Dayton Audio SS18-PR 18" Signature Series Passive Radiator is built for subwoofer systems capable of extreme output and incredible low-frequency extension. Designed to perfectly complement the SS18-22, this passive radiator features the same rugged cast aluminum frame, thick anodized aluminum cone, and high-roll rubber surround, giving it the strength and excursion capability required for the most demanding applications. With Dayton Audio's Sandwich Mass Structure (SMS) tuning system, customizing your system's response for earth-shaking performance has never been easier. Product Highlights Signature Series styling with cast alumSandwich Mass Structure (SMS) keeps added mass stable and symmetrical between spider and surroundinum frame, aluminum cone, and rubber surround - visually identical to the SS18-22 driver Sandwich Mass Structure (SMS) keeps added mass stable and symmetrical between spider and surround Passive radiator design enables extreme low-end extension without the turbulence or cabinet size of large ports Secure, adjustable tuning with threaded bolt, wing nut, and nylock nut assembly Perfect companion for the Dayton Audio SS18-22 in extreme-output passive radiator systems Perfect companion for the Dayton Audio SS18-22 in extreme-output passive radiator systems
